author: hena@gmail.com
fields.caption:
Description : It was late at night, and I was returning home alone after work. During the ride, something felt off. The driver's behavior became increasingly suspicious, and I realized I had no one nearby to call for immediate help.

Instead of ignoring my instincts, I opened the Nirbhoy app and sent an emergency alert. Within moments, my location was shared, volunteers were notified, and support was on the way.

What could have turned into a dangerous situation never got the chance to happen.

Nirbhoy is more than a safety app. It connects users with emergency assistance, volunteer support, legal guidance, and a trusted community ready to help when it matters most.

When I needed help, I wasn't alone.

With Nirbhoy, I reached home safely.
